meta.source: Colours: the official iShot Concept logo (exact pixel values). Layout, type and motion: audit of an editorial photography-studio reference site (Nov 2026) — OBSERVED = measured there, PROPOSED = added.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: BRAND (logo, primary). The iShot Concept navy — wordmark ink. Ink for headings/body on light grounds, primary button fill, `band` sections, header logo. 13.3:1 on white. Fixed in both themes; use semantic tokens (`ink`, `band`) in components.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: BRAND (logo, aperture blade 1). Highlight: booking CTA hover, selected time slot, active markers, Portrait category. FILL ONLY with `on-highlight` text (5.9:1) — never as text on white (3.1:1).

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: BRAND (logo, aperture blade 2). Spectrum accent: Wedding category bar, aperture motif, illustrations. Non-text only on light grounds (3.0:1); text uses `green-text`.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: BRAND (logo, aperture blade 3). Spectrum accent: Headshot category bar, aperture motif. Non-text only on light grounds (3.2:1); text uses `teal-text`.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: BRAND (logo, aperture blade 4). Interactive blue: links, focus ring, current nav, numerals, Maternity category. 5.1:1 on white — safe as text.

tokens.name: brand-navy-mono
tokens.usage: BRAND (one-colour logo ink). Only for the mono logo file; do not use in UI.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light: white, as the logo is drawn on. Dark ('Night'): deep navy derived from `brand-navy`.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: dropdowns, menu panels, form panels, testimonial cards on `band`. Light pairs with a `line` border.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Secondary ground (navy-tinted): alternating sections, image placeholders, stat strips, booking summary. `ink` 12:1, `ink-muted` 6.6:1, `accent` 4.6:1 on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All headings and body text. Light = brand navy (13.3:1 on `paper`, 12:1 on `mist`); dark 16.7:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, eyebrows, captions, meta. 7.3:1 on `paper`, 6.6:1 on `mist`; dark 8.6:1 on `paper`, 7.2:1 on `mist`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: section rules, card dividers. Not for control borders (1.3:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, selects, chips, outline buttons. 3.6:1 on `paper`, 3.2:1 on `mist`; dark 4.9:1.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Inverse full-bleed sections: services, testimonials, footer legal strip, menu sheet. Light = brand navy; dark flips to pale mist so bands still read as bands.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text and outline controls on `band`. 13.3:1 light; 11.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-band-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text on `band`. 8.3:1 light; 6.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interactive accent: text links, focus ring, current-nav underline, numerals, info. 5.1:1 on `paper`; dark 7.5:1. On `band` use `on-band` instead (blue on navy is 2.6:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill (active pagination, info badge solid). 5.1:1 light; 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet selected state: selected date cell, active filter chip ground, newsletter success panel. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Energy accent from the aperture: primary-button hover, selected time slot, 'New'/'Popular' flags, marquee separators. Fill only; text on it is `on-highlight`. Max one highlighted element per view besides hover.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text/icons on a `highlight` fill. 5.9:1.

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange when it must be TEXT (Portrait category label). 5.2:1 on `paper`; dark 7.7:1.

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green when it must be TEXT (Wedding label). 5.3:1 on `paper`; dark 9.2:1.

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Teal when it must be TEXT (Headshot label). 5.1:1 on `paper`; dark 8.8:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 2px offset, on `paper`/`mist` (5.1:1 light, 7.5:1 dark). On `band` and photos use `on-band` / `on-photo`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Navy overlay between photography and `on-photo` type (hero, card overlays).

tokens.name: scrim-strong
tokens.usage: Lightbox and menu backdrop.

tokens.name: on-photo
tokens.usage: Type and controls over photography, always over `scrim`.

tokens.name: photo-ink
tokens.usage: Dark ink for a filled control on photography (lightbox button hover).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, invalid fields, destructive actions. Kept distinct from `highlight` orange; always with icon + word. 6.5:1 on `paper`; dark 10.6:1.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error summary ground; text `ink`, icon `danger`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed / sent states — the brand green at text strength. Icon + word always. 5.3:1; dark 9.2:1.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success panel ground; text `ink`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Limited availability, pending deposit. Amber-brown, distinct from `highlight` and `danger`. 5.4:1; dark 10.6:1.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices. Same blue as `accent`.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: OBSERVED. Hero wordmark/one-word statement only (288 desktop · 160 tablet · 104 mobile). Uppercase. Max 2 words.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: OBSERVED. Centered manifesto statement under the hero (72 / 56 / 36). Uppercase, max 3 lines.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: OBSERVED. Section titles (60 / 48 / 36). Uppercase, break manually into 2 lines.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: OBSERVED. Feature-list titles and CTA band headline (48 / 40 / 32).

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: OBSERVED (mobile section title). Page sub-sections, founder name, article H2 (36 / 32 / 28).

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: OBSERVED. Feature item titles, form step titles (24 / 24 / 22).

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: OBSERVED. Card titles: category, blog, project (20 at every size).

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: PROPOSED. Footer column heads, table heads, lightbox titles.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: OBSERVED. Testimonial body — Oswald bold, sentence case, 18/25.
styles.sample: Thank you so much — everyone loved the photos.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: PROPOSED. Intro paragraph under a page title; max 60ch.
styles.sample: Editorial photography for people and brands.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Long-form article copy sits at eighteen pixels.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: OBSERVED. Default copy, section intros (`ink-muted`), founder bio uses 16/26.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: OBSERVED. Card descriptions, feature descriptions, footer links, form help.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: OBSERVED. Image credits, legal line, meta (read time).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: OBSERVED (1.2px at 12px). Uppercase label above section titles and as category tags. `ink-muted`.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: OBSERVED. Uppercase labels on md/lg buttons and text links (VIEW ALL →).

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: OBSERVED. Header BOOK NOW, cookie actions, chips.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: OBSERVED pattern. Index numerals in service tiles and steps (01, 02). `accent` on paper, `on-band-muted` on band.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Reset.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow→title, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding (md), input inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Mobile card gap, label→input, paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter (OBSERVED px-6); card grid gap (OBSERVED gap-6); button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button lg horizontal (OBSERVED px-8); title→intro.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Feature item text indent (OBSERVED pl-10); stacked block gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section header → content on mobile; column gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tablet gutter (OBSERVED md:px-16); standard section padding (OBSERVED py-16); md grid gap (gap-16).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter (OBSERVED lg:px-20); hero section padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Tall section padding (OBSERVED py-24).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Statement / CTA section padding on desktop (OBSERVED md:py-32).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero bottom offset on xl screens; page-top breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: OBSERVED (--radius: 0rem). Default for every rectangle: buttons, inputs, cards, images, menus.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: OBSERVED. Circular only: social icon buttons (40px), service-tile icon rings, avatar, carousel dots.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default. The system separates with hairlines and tone, not elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: OBSERVED (--dash-shadow). Dropdowns, date-picker popover, sticky booking summary.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Mobile menu sheet and modal panels only.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: OBSERVED. Section top rules, card outlines, inputs, outline buttons.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Active nav underline, focus ring width, selected chip outline.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (plus not-allowed cursor; never the only cue).

tokens.name: opacity-muted
tokens.usage: OBSERVED. Footer meta and tagline on band (only above 4.5:1 — check).

tokens.name: opacity-hover-image
tokens.usage: Image dims on card hover while caption rises.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Flow content.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: Card hover overlays, sticky section labels.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: OBSERVED (z-50). Fixed header.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, date picker.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Mobile menu sheet, scrims.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Lightbox, dialogs.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Cookie banner, toasts.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Inline icons in buttons and links.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default UI icons (social, menu, close).

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Service-tile pictograms, lightbox controls.

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: OBSERVED. Circular social / icon buttons on desktop.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on touch layouts (exceeds WCAG 2.2 24px).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, md buttons.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Header BOOK NOW, chips.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: OBSERVED desktop header (72px below 768).

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Testimonial avatars.

layout.note: Containers are gutters, not centred boxes: content spans the viewport minus the gutter until container-max.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Content stops growing past 1440 + gutters; centred beyond.

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Grids and galleries at 1440 viewport (1440 − 2×80).

tokens.name: container-content
tokens.usage: OBSERVED (max-w-6xl). Founder/about split layouts, booking form + summary.

tokens.name: container-text
tokens.usage: Article body, form single column, centred statements.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: OBSERVED px-6. Page side margin below 768.

tokens.name: gutter-tablet
tokens.usage: OBSERVED md:px-16. 768–1023.

tokens.name: gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: OBSERVED lg:px-20. ≥1024.

tokens.name: grid-gap
tokens.usage: OBSERVED gap-6. Card grids.

tokens.name: grid-gap-lg
tokens.usage: OBSERVED md:gap-16. Split layouts (text | image).

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones landscape: 2-up image strips.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: OBSERVED md. Tablet: 2-column grids, tablet gutter, header shows CTA.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: OBSERVED lg. Desktop gutter, 3–4 column grids.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Large desktop: hero type reaches max.

tokens.name: bp-2xl
tokens.usage: Container stops growing.

tokens.name: ratio-hero
tokens.usage: Hero slides (min-height 100svh, cover-cropped).

tokens.name: ratio-landscape
tokens.usage: OBSERVED. Category cards (625×469).

tokens.name: ratio-portrait
tokens.usage: OBSERVED. Gallery masonry default tile (310×387).

tokens.name: ratio-square
tokens.usage: OBSERVED. Gallery accent tile, avatars.

tokens.name: ratio-tall
tokens.usage: OBSERVED. Centre image in about strip (315×473).

tokens.name: ratio-strip
tokens.usage: OBSERVED. Side images in about strip (189×378).

tokens.name: ratio-wide
tokens.usage: Article lead image, CTA band background.

duration.note: Motion values, mirrored in README › Motion.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: OBSERVED. Colour/background transitions on buttons, links, icon buttons.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menu open, accordion, caption reveal.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Scroll reveal, hero slide cross-fade.

tokens.name: duration-image
tokens.usage: OBSERVED. Image scale on card hover.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: OBSERVED. Colour and state changes.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: OBSERVED. Image zoom, entering elements.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Leaving elements (menu close).

tokens.name: ease-editorial
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Slow-settling reveals of headlines and slides.
